settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Store configuration and carriers
settings.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
settings.courierKeysDesc: Connect the carriers you ship with. Credentials are encrypted and never shown again once saved.
settings.apiCredentialKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved credential
settings.webhookSecretDesc: Shared secret this carrier sends back as the x-api-key header.
settings.webhookUrlDesc: Paste this into the carrier’s portal so it can notify you of status changes.
settings.carriersDesc: Connect your Aramex account so labels and pickups can be requested from the orders page. Credentials are encrypted and never shown again once saved.
settings.aramexCredentialsHint: Issued by Aramex when your contract is signed.
settings.aramexTestModeHint: Sends requests to ws.dev.aramex.net. Turn this off only once Aramex has given you live credentials.
settings.shipperDetailsHint: Where Aramex collects from. Required on every label, and used as the pickup address.
settings.shippingDefaultsWarning: Ask Aramex which values apply to your account. The defaults are for international express and may not suit domestic parcels.

errors.INVALID_VARIANTS: One or more variants are invalid or do not belong to this store.
errors.ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE: Only pending orders can be cancelled. Orders already with a courier cannot be recalled here.
errors.NEGATIVE_STOCK: Adjustment would result in negative physical stock.
errors.STOCK_BELOW_RESERVED: Cannot reduce physical stock below the reserved quantity.
errors.SKU_TAKEN: That SKU already exists on this product.
errors.VARIANT_HAS_RESERVED: Cannot archive this item — some units are currently with a courier. Wait for those shipments to complete first.
errors.SLUG_INVALID_FORMAT: Slug must be lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
errors.COURIER_DISABLED: This carrier is turned off. Enable it in Settings first.
errors.COURIER_API_ERROR: The carrier rejected the request. Check the details in Settings.
errors.COURIER_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the carrier. Try again in a moment.
errors.COURIER_AUTH_REJECTED: The carrier rejected the credential. Check it in Settings.
errors.COURIER_BAD_RESPONSE: The carrier replied in an unexpected format.
errors.COURIER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING: This carrier has no API credential saved. Add one in Settings.
errors.CARRIER_CREDENTIAL_EMPTY: Enter a credential or leave the field blank.
errors.ORDER_NOT_PENDING: This order already has a label.
errors.ORDER_NOT_READY: Its label is not generated yet.
errors.LABEL_NOT_STORED: Its label was not saved and cannot be reprinted.
errors.LABEL_UNREADABLE: Its label file could not be read.
errors.AWB_NOT_RECORDED: The carrier issued a label but it could not be saved. Check with the carrier before retrying.
errors.TOO_MANY_ORDERS_SELECTED: Too many orders selected at once. Select fewer and try again.
errors.ARAMEX_NOT_CONFIGURED: Aramex is not set up yet. Add your account details in Settings.
errors.ARAMEX_SHIPPER_INCOMPLETE: Your pickup address and contact details are incomplete. Fill them in under Settings before generating labels.
errors.ARAMEX_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Aramex rejected your username or password.
errors.ARAMEX_INVALID_ACCOUNT: Aramex rejected your account number or PIN.
errors.ARAMEX_ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: Your Aramex account is blocked. Contact Aramex.
errors.ARAMEX_DUPLICATE_REFERENCE: Aramex already has a shipment with this reference.
errors.ARAMEX_MISSING_FIELD: Aramex rejected the request because a required field was missing. Check your Aramex settings.
errors.ARAMEX_ENTITY_INVALID: The account entity is a 3-character code from Aramex.
errors.ARAMEX_VERSION_INVALID: The API version can be at most 4 characters.
errors.ARAMEX_PRODUCT_GROUP_INVALID: Product group is a code of up to 3 characters, e.g. EXP.
errors.ARAMEX_PRODUCT_TYPE_INVALID: Product type is a code of up to 3 characters, e.g. PPX.
